Name: Better Farm Cave Forage - WAG and RaTA
Author: atelier99
Description:
[center][size=5][img]https://imgur.com/EDfY2f3.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[size=5]Fruits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]﻿ and *[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist [/url]﻿can now spawn in your farm cave! [/size]
[i]*WAG is a required mod to install. Installing RaTA will grant optional content.[/i]
[size=4]
Fruits will appear every day, even in mushroom caves. There are three spawn variants: [b]Seasonal[/b], which spawns only in-season fruits in the cave; [b]OffSeason[/b], which spawns fruit from opposing seasons (spring/fall, summer/winter) in the farm cave; [b]AllYear[/b], which spawns [u]ALL[/u] fruits, regardless of season.[/size]

[size=4][b]AllYear[/b]: Spawns are limited from 3-8 a day, and will despawn after 2 days.
[b]OffSeason[/b]: Spawns are limited from 2-5 a day, and will despawn after 4 days.
[b]Seasonal[/b] [i](default)[/i]: Spawns are limited from 1-3 a day, and will despawn after 7 days.[/size]

[size=4]These spawn variants can be toggled between in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22926]Cauldron[/url]﻿ config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿. See the "Better Farm Cave Forage Options" tab.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/WbWjPPf.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=4][quote][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for granting me a page in her Cauldron config for my Better Farm Cave Forage pack.
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/acearohippo?gameId=1303]acearohippo[/url]﻿ for granting blanket permissions on allowing people to update their mods. Even though I coded this myself, the idea came from their WAG pack, so I owe them the inspiration!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/EscaMMC?gameId=1303]Esca[/url]﻿ for Farm Type Manager, as well as assistance with filling out conditions for FTM![/quote][/size]
